sql: SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) AS v FROM UNNEST([2,NULL,1]) AS x ORDER BY x
note: BigQuery NULLS FIRST for ASC; translate emits NULLS FIRST explicitly for DuckDB

sql: SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) AS v FROM UNNEST([2,NULL,1]) AS x ORDER BY x DESC
SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) AS x, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY x) AS rn FROM UNNEST([2,NULL,1]) AS x ORDER BY rn
SELECT STRING_AGG(lbl, ',' ORDER BY k) AS v FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('b' AS lbl, 2 AS k),('a',NULL),('c',1)])
SELECT REGEXP_CONTAINS('abc', r'^a') AS v
SELECT REGEXP_CONTAINS('café', r'^\w+$') AS v
note: RE2 \w is ASCII-only in both engines -> é fails

sql: SELECT REGEXP_CONTAINS('a9', r'\d') AS v
SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT('a123b', r'([0-9]+)') AS v
SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE('2024-01', r'(\d+)-(\d+)', r'\2/\1') AS v
SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT('<a><b>', r'<(.+?)>') AS v
SELECT SUBSTR('hello', -2) AS v
SELECT SUBSTR('hello', 0) AS v
SELECT LENGTH('café') AS v
SELECT BYTE_LENGTH('café') AS v
SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT('abc', '')) AS v
SELECT TRIM('xxabcxx', 'x') AS v
SELECT LOWER('CAFÉ') AS v
SELECT CONCAT('a', CAST(NULL AS STRING), 'b') AS v
note: translate maps CONCAT to || which propagates NULL like BigQuery CONCAT

sql: SELECT 1 / 0 AS v
note: BigQuery raises on division by zero; DuckDB translation returns inf -> silent wrong value

sql: SELECT CAST('x' AS INT64) AS v
note: BigQuery and DuckDB both raise on CAST failure -> consistent

sql: SELECT [1,2][OFFSET(5)] AS v
note: BigQuery raises on OFFSET out of range; DuckDB translation returns NULL

sql: SELECT CAST([1,2][SAFE_OFFSET(5)] AS STRING) AS v
DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT 1; IF x = 1 THEN SET x = 2; END IF; SELECT x AS v
note: binder does not pretend to execute IF/SET control flow (kind=multiple, unbound)

sql: DECLARE i INT64 DEFAULT 0; WHILE i < 3 DO SET i = i + 1; END WHILE; SELECT i AS v
DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT 5; IF true THEN SET x = 9; END IF; SELECT x AS v
DECLARE v INT64 DEFAULT 99; SELECT v FROM UNNEST([1,2]) AS v ORDER BY v
note: column v shadows the variable; BigQuery uses the column (1,2) but the binder substitutes 99 into the SELECT -> silent wrong binding

sql: DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT 5; SELECT 'x marks x' AS v
note: binder correctly does not substitute inside a string literal

sql: DECLARE s STRUCT<a INT64> DEFAULT STRUCT(1 AS a); SELECT s.a AS v
note: DECLARE STRUCT neither binds nor declines; leaves unresolved s.a and emits broken SQL

sql: SELECT STRUCT(1 AS a, 2 AS b).a AS v
SELECT s.a AS v FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS a), STRUCT(2 AS a)]) AS s ORDER BY v
SELECT * EXCEPT(b) FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 2 AS b, 3 AS c)
SELECT * REPLACE(a * 10 AS a) FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 2 AS b)
